June through August is when DFW and North Texas riders push hardest.

More jackpots. More travel. Longer stretches between rest days. And horses that are already carrying something small from the spring season now have to carry it through the busiest months of the year.

Maintenance chiropractic isn't a luxury — it's what keeps a small problem from becoming a scratch.

Dr. Leo is a cAVCA-certified equine chiropractor. He's mobile — no trailering a tired horse. He pulls up to your barn, does a full exam, and adjusts what needs adjusting. That's it.

If you've been meaning to get your horse seen before the schedule gets away from you, this week is a good time.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or (406) 799-3369.
